channel.title: Quick Dungeon Crawler Blog
channel.description: Official updates and patch notes for Quick Dungeon Crawler.

item.title: Update 4.1.7: Reroll Dice & 13 New Languages
item.description: Update 4.1.7 makes rerolls readable with dice counters, fixes rerolls with locked stats, lowers Refine Stone costs for locked rerolls and adds 13 new languages.
item.author: 7underlines

item.title: Update 4.1.6: Stat Locks & Finite Regeneration
item.description: Update 4.1.6 adds Stat Locks for rerolls, stronger endgame equipment and custom Auto Equip controls, plus a finite healing reserve for Regenerating enemies.
item.author: 7underlines

item.title: Update 4.1.1: Forge Tokens & Merchant Improvements
item.description: Update 4.1.1 introduces limited Forge access through Forge Tokens, improves Wandering Merchant offers, and adds several balance and reliability updates.
item.author: 7underlines

item.title: Update 4.1.0: New Equipment Slots
item.description: Update 4.1.0 introduces six dedicated equipment slots, safe save migration, and a free Heirloom Accessory for existing players.
item.author: 7underlines

item.title: Update 4.0.1: Curse Levels 15 and Endgame Progression
item.description: Update 4.0.1 expands the endgame to Curse Level and Equipment Tier 15, improves Dungeon Monarch rewards, and adds new Forge and combat quality-of-life features.
item.author: 7underlines

item.title: Update 3.9.1: Reroll Stats and Wandering Shop
item.description: Update 3.9.1 adds equipment stat rerolls, a wandering merchant event, and clearer Aegis Thorns combat feedback.
item.author: 7underlines

item.title: Update 3.8.4: Enemy Modifier Badge
item.description: Update 3.8.4 adds visual enemy type badges, saving bugfixes, and improved translations.
item.author: 7underlines

item.title: Update 3.8.2
item.description: Update 3.8.2 brings balance changes, a new boss encounter, and 8 new languages.
item.author: 7underlines

item.title: Update 3.8.0: Enemy Customization
item.description: Update 3.8.0 adds enemy customization, bestiary upgrades, and new quality-of-life options.
item.author: 7underlines

item.title: Update 3.7.4: Boots, New Classes, and Attack Speed Cap
item.description: New boots increase run speed, added Rogue and Scout classes, raised attack speed cap.
item.author: 7underlines

item.title: Update 3.6.0: Post-Run Summary Screen – See Your Dungeon Stats After Death
item.description: Update 3.6.0 introduces a run summary screen.
item.author: 7underlines

item.title: Update 3.5.0: New passives, CRIT DMG nerf
item.description: Update 3.5.0 introduces new passive abilities, nerfs to critical damage, and buffs to health and defense growth.
item.author: 7underlines

item.title: Update 3.0.0: Classes and Translations
item.description: Knight and Paladin classes, JP/DE/ES translations, buffed passives, UI onboarding.
item.author: 7underlines

item.title: Update 2.9.8: Auto Mode and IAP Changes
item.description: Introducing Auto Mode for a more relaxed gameplay experience, optional In-App Purchase.
item.author: 7underlines

item.title: Update 2.9.0: Inventory Limits
item.description: New inventory limits, enemy dodge mechanic, and bestiary improvements in Quick Dungeon Crawler v2.9.0.
item.author: 7underlines

item.title: Update 2.8.0: Dodge Mechanic
item.description: A new dodge feature adds a chance to avoid hits, capped at 75%.
item.author: 7underlines

item.title: Hardcore Mode in v2.7.4
item.description: Try the new Hardcore option where death wipes your items and gold.
item.author: 7underlines

item.title: Update 2.7.0: Bestiary – Track Every Monster You Encounter
item.description: Track every enemy you encounter or defeat with the new Bestiary.
item.author: 7underlines

item.title: July 2025 Patch Notes – Quick Dungeon Crawler Updates
item.description: Highlights from the recent Quick Dungeon Crawler commits, including auto-equip, a Rate Game button, and more.
item.author: 7underlines

item.title: The Forge – Quick Dungeon Crawler's New Upgrade System
item.description: Announcing The Forge, Quick Dungeon Crawler’s new upgrade system. Declutter your bag, power up fast.
item.author: 7underlines
